pages.title: Redstone Crystal
pages.text: Mine regular or deepslate redstone ore with a suitable tool. With a normal loot drop, each ore has a 15% chance to add a crystal. You can also craft a crystal with redstone dust and an Ender Shard.

pages.title: Eyes and Moon Stone
pages.text: The Eye of Redstone is a crafted redstone component. The Moon Stone uses Lunar Reactive Dust made by the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:machines/resonator)Resonator$(/l). Use Moon Stone to craft Ethereal Glass.
